notes.title: Free Rare Weekend!
notes.notes:
Get Ready to Go Bananas!

This weekend, seize the chance to get a guaranteed [b]Rare [/b]Monkey! It’s the perfect opportunity to expand your collection with a special addition. 
Don’t miss out on this exciting event – gather your friends, dive into the adventure, and enjoy the thrill of the hunt. 
Whether you’re a seasoned collector or just starting, this is your moment!

Have fun, and happy collecting!

You can now play the game from any devices without losing bananas!

notes.title: Monkey Exchange is here! Trade in Monkeys for Crates!
notes.notes:
[b]Introducing an exciting new feature:[/b] 
Trade in 25 monkeys for a crate with the same rarity as the monkeys! This innovative addition enhances the fun of collecting by giving players the chance to obtain much rarer monkeys from these crates. Whether you're a seasoned collector or just starting, this feature adds an extra layer of strategy and excitement, making every trade a potential treasure trove of rare and unique monkeys. Dive in and see what rare finds await you!

notes.title: City Night Event!
notes.notes:
[b]Get ready for the upcoming City Night Event[/b], where the excitement reaches new heights! During this special event, players can get exclusive loot drops available only for a limited time. 

Make sure to participate and take full advantage of this event to elevate your in-game experience and stand out from the crowd with your new treasures. 
Don't miss out on the chance to collect these special rewards before they're gone!
From the 12th of July at 7:00 AM UTC until the 15th of July at 4:00 AM UTC!

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Get Ready to Go Bananas!

We are super excited to announce the release of Banana Monkeys! Dive into the wild and wacky world where your mission is to collect as many monkeys as you can. Swing through lush jungles, solve fun puzzles, and embark on thrilling adventures. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore gamer, Banana Monkeys promises endless fun and excitement.
Marketplace Collaboration with Steam

We're thrilled to share that we're working with Steam to get the item market up and running! Soon, you'll be able to trade and sell your collected monkeys and unique items. This feature will enhance your gameplay experience, allowing you to showcase your rare finds and make your collection even more impressive.
Start Collecting Today!

Don't miss out on the fun – start collecting those monkeys now and see how many you can gather. Swing into action and immerse yourself in the playful world of Banana Monkeys. We can't wait to see you in the game!

Download Banana Monkeys today and let the monkey madness begin!
